hypotheses.G0_layer0_prefers_the_native_chart: The prospective all-chart router selects native on at least half of examples in both Layer-0 corpus cells.
hypotheses.G1_layer1_prefers_rotated_charts: The prospective all-chart router selects native on less than half of examples in both Layer-1 corpus cells.
hypotheses.G2_all_chart_router_matches_the_all_char: The all-chart router is within 0.03 median fidelity of the finite all-chart oracle in every cell.
hypotheses.G3_adding_chart_options_does_not_harm_ty: All-chart router minus native has pair median at least -0.02 in every cell.
hypotheses.G4_layer1_adaptive_charts_improve_on_nat: In both Layer-1 corpus cells, all-chart router beats native by at least 0.03 with pair-bootstrap 95% interval above zero.
hypotheses.G5_depth_changes_chart_preference: The rotated-choice fraction is at least 0.20 higher in Layer 1 than Layer 0 on both corpora.
